<span id="the-loop"></span>
== The loop ==

# Read the project’s <code>CLEAN_ROOM.md</code> and README. Contributions to every project follow its clean-room policy.
# Find or open an issue. For anything larger than a small fix, say what you plan to do before you start.
# Work only from public material. Record the source of any reference you add (provenance).
# Add or update tests. Compatibility tests against real vendor SDKs decide what counts as done.
# Open a pull request. A human reviews every change before merge.
# Say plainly in the pull request whether AI wrote part of it.

<span id="where-to-start"></span>
== Where to start ==

* [[ZeroAuthy]] and [[SalesCompel]] each describe what works and what is missing, so you can choose a gap.
* The Rust port of any project is an open invitation: open an issue naming the project.
